method.prior: Northeast > southwest/southeast > central/northwest as an ordinal template, with learned domestic residuals and nonnegative shade/vintage gates. Within-tier equality not forced.
method.prior_assumptions: Centered template [2,1,1,0,0], weak mean-gate target 0.1 in preference units; 20-year gates softly shrink toward zero. Weak premium-region20 vs central/northwest30 prior at equal shade and 130-vs110 tare, not synthetic observations. No fixed 20-vs25 dominance assumption.
method.scope: Regional overlay only; baseline offering and local tare curves held fixed within each training fold. Pure-tare differences exactly preserved. Foreign-only comparisons unchanged.
method.validation: Same current-v8 outer family assignments and training-selected offering settings. Inner 3 family folds refit offering and regional layer on inner training only, selecting prior strength by balanced accuracy. No held-out outcomes used. Existing baseline predictions reproduced exactly.
method.limits: Exploratory user-informed prior; sparse evidence for young premium-region dominance. No pristine holdout or calibrated dollar prices. Layer adds 30 parameters; constrained to preserve weak ordering.
